content.short: Free onchain token vesting and lockups for teams, investors, and communities.
content.description: Hedgey provides a token distribution and vesting platform with onchain tools to allocate tokens across the full cap table—investors, advisors, employees, founders, and the broader community or DAO. Its vesting and lockup schedules are automated, while governance and other onchain capabilities are enabled directly within the platform, helping teams manage token allocations, timing, and participation across programs without leaving the blockchain. This focused approach supports efficient token distribution and onchain governance for diverse stakeholders and ecosystems.
